name: Planning Poker
highLevelGoals: The Moderator aims to efficiently guide the team through the estimation process to collectively set sprint goals, ensuring productive discussions and shared understanding.
The Moderator seeks to easily manage and modify game details, including adding, editing, and deleting items for estimation, to reflect the team's evolving understanding.
The Moderator desires a straightforward process for creating new games and inviting estimators, minimizing setup time and maximizing participation.
The Moderator wants to control when estimates are revealed and to easily accept agreed-upon estimates, facilitating quick decision-making and progression.
The Moderator aims to have the flexibility to re-estimate stories and import items from external sources, adapting to dynamic team needs during a session.
The Moderator needs to browse, view, and export transcripts of previous games to maintain records and analyze past estimations.
The Moderator needs to create, log in to, modify, and delete their account, as well as retrieve forgotten passwords, to securely manage their access to the application.
The Moderator aims to customize estimation scales (e.g., Fibonacci, Powers of 2) and manage timezone settings to align the game with their team's preferences and operational context.
The Estimator aims to join games seamlessly and submit their estimates for items, contributing to the collective sprint goal setting.
The Estimator seeks clear visibility of the current item and all items to be estimated, enabling informed decision-making during the process.
The Participant wants to see who has estimated what and receive immediate notifications of estimates, fostering transparency and facilitating discussions.
The Participant desires the ability to view prior estimates and change their current estimate until the round is complete, allowing for dynamic adjustments during discussions.
The Participant aims to initiate and reset a countdown timer to ensure discussions remain focused and efficient.
The Participant wants to review past stories and estimates to inform their current estimations and understand the evolution of discussions.
lowLevelGoals: The Moderator can initiate a new estimation game by providing a unique name and a brief description for the session.
The Moderator can input details for a new item (e.g., user story, task) that needs to be estimated by the team.
The Moderator can modify the title, description, or other attributes of an item that has already been added to the game.
The Moderator can remove an item from the list of items to be estimated in the current game session.
The Moderator can obtain a shareable link that participants can use to join the active game.
The Moderator can choose an item from the list of game items to be the active item for the current estimation round.
The Moderator can make the details of the active item visible to all connected estimators.
The Moderator can trigger the display of all individual estimates submitted by participants for the current item.
The Moderator can finalize the estimation for the current item by selecting and recording the team's agreed-upon value.
The Moderator can manually input a specific value as the agreed-upon estimate for the current item, distinct from accepting an average.
The Moderator can reset the estimation for the current item, allowing participants to submit new estimates.
The Moderator can upload a file containing multiple items to be added to the current game session.
The Moderator can view a historical record of all completed estimation games.
The Moderator can access the full history of an individual game, including items, estimates, and accepted values.
The Moderator can download the data from a completed game session for external record-keeping or analysis.
The Moderator can create a new user account to access the application's features.
The Moderator can gain access to their account by providing their registered credentials.
The Moderator can modify details such as their name, email, or password within their account settings.
The Moderator can initiate a process to regain access to their account if they have forgotten their password.
The Moderator can permanently remove their user account and associated data from the application.
The Moderator can choose from predefined estimation scales (Fibonacci or Powers of 2) to be used in the game.
The Moderator can specify the local timezone for the game to ensure accurate timekeeping for all participants.
The Estimator can enter a game by clicking on a provided link or entering a game ID.
The Estimator can select a value from the available estimation scale and submit it for the item being discussed.
The Estimator can see the title and description of the item currently under discussion.
The Estimator can see the backlog of items that are part of the current game session.
The Participant can see the individual estimates provided by each team member once the Moderator reveals them.
The Participant is alerted immediately when another team member submits their estimate for the current item.
The Participant can see what value they previously selected for the item before the estimates are revealed.
The Participant can see how other estimators' opinions changed for the current story during the estimation round.
The Participant can modify their submitted estimate if new information or discussion changes their perspective.
The Participant can initiate a timer to manage the duration of discussions for an item.
The Participant can restart the discussion timer if more time is needed or if the discussion takes a new turn.
The system will automatically reset the discussion timer once all active participants have submitted their estimates for the current item.
The Participant can access information about items that have already been estimated and finalized in the ongoing session.
The Moderator can view a comprehensive list of all items that have been added to the current game session, regardless of their estimation status.
The system will automatically finalize the estimation for the current item if all active participants submit identical estimates.
The Moderator can paste a block of text, typically from a spreadsheet, to create multiple new items for estimation in the current game.
The Moderator can permanently remove a game session and all its associated data.
The Moderator can view a real-time indicator of which participants have already submitted an estimate for the current item, before estimates are revealed.
The Participant can access a log of their own previous estimates for the current item, if they have changed their mind during the round.
The system supports a maximum of 15 participants simultaneously joining and submitting estimates in an active game.
The system will display all dates and times within the application according to the user's local timezone setting.
